answers.explanation: Replacing the durable SQL system of record with an incompatible append-only service is architecturally significant and hard to reverse, so intentionally omitting an ADR violates policy. It also conflicts with merged ADR-001's synchronous-delivery decision and must explicitly address that constraint rather than silently override it. Revise the proposal to include one new ADR documenting context, alternatives and rejection reasons, consequences, migration implications, and concrete reconsideration conditions, paired in the same resulting main commit with a substantive, self-contained ARCHITECTURE.md update. Preserve ADR-001 unchanged except for a superseded-status link if the new decision replaces it, preserve unrelated work, and obtain independent semantic review. Authority and history are resolved, so the known proposal defect requires revision rather than an owner inquiry.
